newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EMU budget pact possible by December-De Silguy.
newsitem.headline: EMU budget pact possible by December-De Silguy.

text.p: European Monetary Affairs Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy on Wednesday said the European Union would likely reach an accord next month on a budget stability pact for those joining a common currency.
Speaking at a news conference, De Silguy defended a recent Commission proposal on the issue.
"We hope this is going to be completed in Dublin," de Silguy said in reference to an EU summit of leaders in Dublin on December 13 and 14.
German officials have argued that the Commission's proposal, released last month, lacked the kind of rigour seen necessary to ensure budgetary discipline among countries inside a monetary union.
In particular, Germany has criticised the lack of a precise definition of the economic circumstances under which a country running an excessive deficit could avoid penalties.
"This is not the essential point," de Silguy said. "To justify this in economic terms is not that easy."
